elements.name: furo-backdrop
elements.description:
show content with backdrop
---


### **Events:**
 - **closed** - The **closed** event will be fired when the displayed content is invisible and the backdrop is closed. Tipp: Maybe you want to use this event to refocus the initiator. Event.details {FuroBackdrop} is the reference to the emiting DOM node.
- **opened** - The **opened** event will be fired when the content is visible on the backdrop. Tipp: you can use this to focus something on the shown content. Event.details {FuroBackdrop} is the reference to the emiting DOM node.
- **register-backdrop** - Internal event to move the contents to the backdrop-display. Event.details {FuroBackdrop} is the reference to the emiting DOM node.

### **Methods:**
 - **close()** - Hides the display.

**Note:** The display will also get closed when the user clicks on the backdrop.
- **show()** - Initiates the backdrop and shows the content on top of the backdrop area.

elements.name: furo-backdrop-display
elements.description:
Display component for furo-backdrop
---


### **Methods:**
 - **close()** - closes the backdrop.
You can close the backdrop on the display element, this is useful when you want to close the backdrops on page
changes.

Usually the component which triggers the backdrop or is displayed closes it.

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--furo-backdrop-color** - background color of backdrop _(default: #6d6d6d)_

attributes.name: show
attributes.description: Indicates that the backdrop is shown.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Needed to start the animation.

attributes.name: to-duration
attributes.description:
Timeout duration, to wait to notify the changes.

Note: the animations in the css are set with 250ms.

If you are interested to use at-opened to load some data, set this value lower. This gives you 250 ms extra time to load content, without feeling slow.

If you are interested to use at-opened to show some ui stuff, set this value higher or equal 250.

elements.name: furo-responsive-layout
elements.description:
### Overview Use the furo-responsive-layout to structure your forms or other content. The heights are given by the highest `cell` in a `row`. > **Deprecation Warning:** The short form attributes (`tripple` instead of `layout-tripple`) will be removed in near future **(end of Q3/24)** It is based on a grid system with the following properties: #### Layout one ```html
Item
Item
layout-double
Item
Item
 ``` #### Layout two If the container size is smaller than `breakpoint-big` the layout will collapse in a layout one. #### Layout three If the container size is smaller than `breakpoint-big` the layout will collapse in a layout one. #### Layout four If the container size is smaller than `breakpoint-big` the layout will collapse in a layout two. If the container size is smaller than `breakpoint-small` the layout will collapse in a layout one. #### Layout six If the container size is smaller than `breakpoint-big` the layout will collapse in a layout three. If the container size is smaller than `breakpoint-small` the layout will collapse in a layout one. The ResponsiveLayout component is nestable, this means that you can put 2 six column ResponsiveLayouters in a two column ResponsiveLayout component. ### How to set the sizes Set the following **attributes** to set the space your item should take. - **layout-double** Uses 2 columns. - **layout-tripple** Uses 3 columns. - **layout-full** Uses the full width. - **layout-newline** Starts always on a new line. - **layout-end** Sticks to the end. > This layouter is a clone of the furo-form-layouter component with a slightly different API. ### ES6 Module Import `import "@furo/layout/dist/furo-responsive-layout.js";` --- ### **Events:** - **layout-changed** ### **Slots:** - _default_ - slot to add content. ### **CSS Properties:** - **--GridRowGapSize** - width of row gap _(default: undefined)_ - **--GridColumnGapSize** - width of column gap _(default: undefined)_
